subject: Authentication system with persistent data storage for multiple users

messages.author: dbb5325125d3845c
messages.subject: Authentication system with persistent data storage for multiple users
parts:
I am currently involved in a project where I am creating a machine learning flashcard application, and plan to use shinyapps.io. The application will be tested in a class, with multiple students trialing the application. 

Is it possible to create an authentication system with shiny where each student can create an account, and their progress will be stored in a specific database (eg. mysql, dropbox etc), so when they re-login, they will continue where they left off? Basically, storing data for each user in a database, and then querying the information for that specific user. My approach would be to store user information in a cookie, and then use that information to query the database. 

Is it possible to do this in the lowest paid ($9/month) shinyapps.io package? Does this package allow me to store persistent data, read cookies, and ultimately create an authentication system for different users?

Thanks for your time.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Authentication system with persistent data storage for multiple users
parts:
There is no persistent storage provided with shinyapps.io today, although it is something we are actively pursuing.
All plans allow your application to access persistent storage you have elsewhere though.
